name: Dockyard
author: nixfred
description: Docker containers cockpit. A whale and the running count on the bar; the panel lists every container with state, CPU, memory, ports and uptime, with start, stop, restart and logs on a click. Also shows image disk usage, dangling images, build cache, GPU containers and a stale CDI spec check. Talks to the local Engine API socket; read-only unless you click.

barWidget.description: Running containers on the bar. Click for the cockpit.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the Engine API is polled. A poll is a few socket calls and cgroup reads.
